statement: I've heard everyone, and I'm moving Alder to first. Here's the count. Five of us, Delegates 2, 4, 7, 8 and 11, will not vote for Cedar, so Cedar tops out at seven. Hazel and Birch can't reach nine either. Alder is the plan most of this room has already said it can live with: Delegates 1, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10 and 11 named it, and so do I. That makes eight. We need one more. Delegates 3, 6, 9 and 12: under Alder the top fifth goes from 252 to 242, about four percent. If you hold out, you get today, and that's no gain for you either. For me Alder means 32 instead of 22, plus health coverage I don't have now. I'm not asking you to take Hazel. I'm asking one of you to take a small cost so this convention doesn't walk away with nothing for a generation. Cedar stays last on my ballot.
